notes.title: Patch Notes (1.1.1)
notes.notes:
Hello everybody!

We bring you a couple of small fixes for issues that have been reported in the last weeks:

[list]
[*] Removed a mention to rescuing Leopoldo from a conversation that is displayed when Leopoldo has been already rescued.
[*] Increased the brightness of the green parts of the floor traps again, to make them easier to spot.
[/list]
By the way, we wish you all a happy new year! :D

notes.title: 🔦 Guayota - Patch 1.1 Available NOW 🔥
notes.notes:
Greetings explorers!

I would like to thank all of you who have supported our game in its first month of release. We love the passion you put into your reviews and impressions, and we want to make the game the best it can be.

Since launch, we have uploaded a number of quick fixes to avoid any major blocking bugs or crashes so that you can have the smoothest experience possible. However, we have gathered a lot of feedback from you to build our first major update. In this update you will mainly find some tweaks to the traps to make them more fair. You will also find some other bug fixes and other improvements to the ending of the game.

Finally, we have read that some players have been frustrated by the traps in 'normal' mode. The opinion is that they are quite difficult on the first attempt, and they are actually designed that way. They are there to challenge the player, but we would like to point out that completing levels in this mode is not necessary to progress in the game, nor is it necessary to reach all possible endings. Also, this has some... 'narrative explanation', so we encourage players to take the game as it is and discover what's going on on the island.

Thank you again for your love and support, and we hope new explorers can join us on the journey to paradise on earth!

Sergio González (Sergienso), 
[i]Creative Director[/i]

[h2]Gameplay Improvements[/h2]

[h3]Controls[/h3]
[list]
[*] The rotation speed of the character has been increased, making it feel more responsive.
[/list]
[h3]Traps Rebalance[/h3]
[list]
[*] The intensity of their green light patterns has been increased so traps become easier to spot.
[*] The size of the ‘on-rail’ traps has been increased to better visually represent its hit box.
[*] The velocity of the bubble projectiles has been reduced. However, they are more capable of chasing the player around corners now.
[*] [b][Magec’s Temple | Levels 7 & 8][/b] Trap placement retouches.
[*] [b][Magec’s Temple | Level 7][/b] Added two healing sources, to prevent the player from dying right at the end.
[*] [b][Achaman’s Temple | Level 8][/b] Two wall traps have been removed to avoid unfair situations.[/list]
[h3]Levels[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b][Chaxiraxi’s Temple | Level 7][/b] Some foliage collisions have been removed.
[*] [b][Bonus ‘Real World’ Level][/b] The rails from the ‘on-rail’ traps have been improved so they are easier to spot.
[*] [b][Bonus ‘Alternate World’ Level][/b] Some walls have been made longer so players cannot spoil the puzzle.[/list]
[h3]Localization[/h3]
[list]
[*] Correction of one text in all languages, related to the ending section of the game.
[*] Enhanced the Spanish translation of one text displayed mid game in a conversation with Nicolás.[/list]

[h2]Other Improvements[/h2]

[h3]Ending Section[/h3]
[list]
[*] Some VFX from the levels at the ‘ending section’ of the game now play at the ‘ending section’ foyer, under special conditions.
[*] Reduced the volume of some SFX sounds related to the ending trigger.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

[h3]Gameplay[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug caused by the blocking hand walls from the alternate mode, that could make players unable to interact with any stone or ‘healing’ source, blocking their progress in the level.
[*] Fixed a bug that made the red stones unable to pick sometimes, that forced players to move away and get close again to re-trigger the interaction outline.
[/list]
[h3]Levels[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b][Bonus ‘Real World’ Level][/b] Fixed a bug that made the healing source unusable after dying once.
[*] [b][Bonus ‘Real World’ Level][/b] Fixed a visual bug that made the red stone not display its red pulse over the foliage.
[*] [b][Hidden Temple Lower Foyer][/b] Fixed a bug that played the earthquake effects every time you go to this foyer after opening the staircase.
[/list]
[h3]Music[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that kept the music in Chaxiraxi’s temple levels playing after the ‘victory motiv’, if players got to the mural with their full ‘life’.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes (1.0.10)
notes.notes:
The following problems have been addressed:

[list]
[*] The ending achievements now unlock correctly, granting the corresponding ending achievement and the "both endings" one as well.
[*] The music from the last foyer doesn't leak into the game credits anymore after the ending cutscene.
[*] The game no longer crashes under certain conditions in the forest temple.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes (1.0.09)
notes.notes:
The following bugs have been addressed:
[list]
[*] The game no longer crashes under certain PC configurations.
[*] The titles of the Temple of Magec Big Note are no longer mixed up and do not show the title from one version on the other anymore.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes for Release Day
notes.notes:
Hello, explorers!
We are working fast to correct the bugs you report.

These two bugs have been corrected:

[list]
[*] The game no longer gets locked when the gamepad is disconnected during an in-game sequence, at the end of a level, or during a conversation
[*] Now, at the last level from the Temple of Magec in the "other dimension", the player no longer can cheese the "gas" walls puzzle at the left / west side of the level.
[/list]
